transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh… had an incident at work. In a staff meeting I got kind of worked up and started acting out this fall-prevention thing with chairs and waving my arms around. People told me to sit down, but I… couldn’t really stop right away.
Did you feel like you had to act out that fall-prevention thing, like you couldn't help yourself?
Yeah… kind of. I mean, once I started with the chairs and showing it with my arms, I couldn’t really just stop, even when people were telling me to sit down.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to get rid of?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I haven’t noticed thoughts repeating like that.
Do you often feel like you have to perform certain rituals or behaviors?
Not… not really rituals, no. I don’t think I do things like that a lot.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking through the consequences?
I’m not sure. I mean… sometimes I do things before thinking it all the way through, but I don’t know if it’s often.
Do you often do things without thinking them through?
I don’t really know. I guess sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s something I notice a lot.
Have you gotten into trouble in the past for acting on impulse?

Yeah… I guess so. That’s kind of why I’m here. I got worked up in a staff meeting and started acting out this fall-prevention thing with chairs, waving my arms around. People told me to sit down, but I… I couldn’t really stop right then.
Have you ever gotten into physical fights with others?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had arguments, but physical fights… not really.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?
Not really sure. I mean… maybe sometimes if I’m worked up, but I don’t think I do it a lot.
Have you ever deliberately broken rules or laws?
I mean… not really. Nothing like laws, I don’t think. Rules… maybe small stuff, but not on purpose to cause trouble.
Have you ever lied to get something you wanted?
I don’t know… I mean, everybody tells little lies sometimes, I guess. But to get something I wanted? Not really that I can think of.
Have you ever done something that put others in danger without thinking about the consequences?

I don’t know if I’d say danger exactly… but at work I got really worked up in a staff meeting and started acting out this fall-prevention thing with chairs, waving my arms around. People told me to sit down, and I just… couldn’t seem to stop right away.
Have you ever stolen something?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, maybe borrowed things and forgot to give them back, but stolen? No.
Have you ever done something that you knew could hurt someone else?
No… I don’t think so. Not on purpose, anyway. I try not to do stuff like that.
Have you often acted impulsively in your personal relationships?
I’m not sure. I mean… I don’t think often. Sometimes I might say something too fast or pull back from people, but I wouldn’t call it a pattern.
Have you ever physically hurt someone on purpose?
No… not on purpose. I mean, I don’t think so. I try to keep away from that kind of thing.
Have you ever been in trouble with the law?
Not really… I mean, nothing serious. I haven’t really been in trouble like that.
Do you often act impulsively in your daily life, outside of work?
I don’t think so… not often. I mean, outside work I mostly keep to myself, so there’s not a lot of chances for that. Sometimes I decide things quick, but… I wouldn’t say it’s a big issue.
Have you ever deliberately done something that you knew was wrong or against the rules?
I mean… not really. Maybe little things, like stuff everybody does, but nothing I can think of that was, you know, deliberately trying to break rules.
Have you ever been involved in behaviors that disregarded the rights of others?
I don’t think so. I mean… I try not to bother people or get in anyone’s way. I can’t really think of anything like that.
